note: Proposals only. Nothing here is read by information_gain_gate.py or contract_c_derive.py until ratified by the owner.

proposals.problem: IG answers 'does this object warrant a NEW URL?'. For a Knowledge Object realized by reconstructing the body of its OWN existing same-task route, the honest answer (near_duplicate -> ig_reviewed_no_new_route) is normalized to ig_failed, and Contract C R7 then denies the existing route forever. Reconstruction, the preferred SEO-safe path, can therefore never reach index.
proposals.proposal: Add governed posture ig_reviewed_route_realization: allowed only when (a) the governing pair is KO-vs-its-own canonical route with classification near_duplicate, (b) the KO is bound to that route by a render spec, (c) no other indexable URL serves the same task (verified by the publication-authority surface), and (d) the route path is unchanged. Normalize it to ig_passed. All other near_duplicate cases keep ig_reviewed_no_new_route.
proposals.effect_if_ratified: KO-MOS2-SCIENTIFIC-001 and KO-BISULFID-TERMINOLOGY-001 would clear R7 only; every other Contract C input remains, so nothing becomes indexable by this amendment alone.
proposals.risks: Could be misused to index a same-task duplicate; condition (c) and a test over the authority surface are required with the amendment.
proposals.requires: owner ratification; policy version bump; property tests for the new alias
proposals.defect_found_in_review: Condition (c) was circular: see revision_note in the policy.
